record.context_brief: Order-theoretic characterization of left regular bands
record.original_question: Generalize the order-theoretic characterization described for left normal bands to left regular bands. The source considers a set X with a preorder and a refining partial order, defines lower bounds and infima of ordered pairs using those relations, and says that left normal bands in this order-theoretic sense are precisely left normal bands in the algebraic sense. For left regular bands, what property should replace the condition that if x and y are equivalent for the preorder and both are below z in the partial order, then x = y?

evidence.quote: The basic structure (X, , ≤) consists of a set X with a preorder  and a partial order ≤ which refines  (that is, ≤ ⊆ ).
For a, b ∈ X, an element c ∈ X is said to be a lower bound of the pair (a, b) if c ≤ a and c  b.
left normal bands in the order theoretic sense are precisely the same as left normal bands in the algebraic sense.
Generalize the above characterization to left regular bands. What property should replace (∗)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let X be a set equipped with a preorder ⪯ and a partial order ≤ which refines ⪯ (that is, x ≤ y implies x ⪯ y). For a, b ∈ X, call c ∈ X a lower bound of the ordered pair (a, b) if c ≤ a and c ⪯ b. A greatest lower bound of (a, b) (with respect to ≤ among lower bounds of (a,b)) is called an infimum of (a, b) and denoted a ∧ b when it exists.

Background characterization (left normal bands). One can show that the structures (X, ⪯, ≤) in which every ordered pair has an infimum, together with the condition

(∗) for all x, y, z ∈ X, if x ⪯ y, y ⪯ x and x ≤ z, y ≤ z, then x = y,

are exactly the left normal bands (idempotent semigroups satisfying xyz = xzy) under the assignment a · b := a ∧ b, with ⪯ recovered as the natural preorder of the band (a ⪯ b iff ab = a, equivalently the semilattice congruence ordering) and ≤ recovered as the partial order a ≤ b iff ab = ba = a.

Problem. Find an order-theoretic axiom (∗′) on the basic structure (X, ⪯, ≤) — to replace (∗) — such that the resulting class of structures (X, ⪯, ≤) in which (a, b) ↦ a ∧ b is well-defined corresponds bijectively, via the same assignment a · b := a ∧ b, to the class of left regular bands (idempotent semigroups satisfying xyx = xy). Equivalently, characterize left regular bands order-theoretically in the framework (X, ⪯, ≤, ∧) above by determining the precise condition that must be imposed in place of (∗).
artifact.status_search_result: Searches on order-theoretic characterizations of band varieties surface foundational work (Gerhard–Petrich) and recent work on right-regular bands and definability of band structures on posets, but no source was found that explicitly provides the analogue of the left-normal-band condition (∗) for left regular bands in the (X, ⪯, ≤) framework described. The status of this specific generalization appears unresolved in the accessible literature.

status_evidence.title: Definability of band structures on posets
status_evidence.snippet: Focuses on right-regular bands; does not give the order-theoretic analogue of (∗) for left regular bands.
status_evidence.claim: The closest recent work treats right-regular bands and does not address the precise generalization sought.

status_evidence.title: An Order-Theoretical Characterization of Varieties of Bands
status_evidence.snippet: Order-theoretical characterization of varieties of bands.
status_evidence.claim: General framework exists for varieties of bands, but the specific replacement condition for left regular bands in the (⪯,≤) framework is not identified in retrieved material.

status_evidence.title: Thin MC left regular bands
status_evidence.snippet: Studies left regular bands and their poset structures.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work on left regular bands does not present the specific order-theoretic axiom sought.
